plan.title: Explore data structure and annotations
plan.description: Write a script to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) structure of annotations.json (categories, annotations count, image sizes), (3) distribution of annotations per image, (4) category frequency distribution, (5) sample entries from metadata.json, (6) structure of data/products/ directory (how many products, what images exist). Also examine the existing train_split.json and val_split.json to understand if splits are already created.
plan.success_criteria: Clear understanding of data properties: image count, annotation count, category distribution, image dimensions, split sizes, product reference image availability

plan.title: Examine existing splits and validate them
plan.description: Load train_split.json and val_split.json. Verify they are valid COCO format, check number of images and annotations in each, verify no image overlap, check category coverage in val split, and confirm stratification by store section if section info is available.
plan.success_criteria: Confirmed valid splits with expected ~223 train / ~25 val images, all annotations properly assigned

plan.title: Check environment and install pinned packages
plan.description: Verify installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm. Install ultralytics==8.1.0 if not present. Confirm GPU availability and VRAM. Check that pycocotools is available. List all relevant package versions.
plan.success_criteria: ultralytics==8.1.0 confirmed, torch with CUDA confirmed, 2x A800 GPUs visible

plan.title: Write evaluation function
plan.description: Implement a reusable evaluation function in utils.py that: (1) takes a predictions list (COCO format) and val_split.json path, (2) computes detection_mAP@0.5 (all categories mapped to 1), (3) computes classification_mAP@0.5 (original category_ids), (4) returns val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Use pycocotools COCOeval. Test with dummy predictions to verify it works.
plan.success_criteria: Function returns correct val_score, tested with dummy data, handles edge cases

plan.title: Create YOLO-format dataset from COCO splits
plan.description: Convert train_split.json and val_split.json to YOLO format (txt files with class x_center y_center width height). Create a data.yaml file pointing to the correct directories. Handle the 357 categories (0-356) correctly. Verify a few converted labels visually.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO-format labels created for all train and val images, data.yaml created, spot-check confirms correct conversion

plan.title: Train YOLOv8n baseline with nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline with 357 classes at imgsz=640 establishes a minimum val_score benchmark
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n on the train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Use the evaluation function to compute val_score. This is a quick baseline to verify the full pipeline works end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes, val_score computed and logged. Expect val_score > 0.15

plan.title: Train YOLOv8s with nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves over YOLOv8n due to more capacity for 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s, same settings as baseline but with the small model. Compare val_score to YOLOv8n.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over YOLOv8n baseline

plan.title: Train YOLOv8m with nc=357 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Medium model at higher resolution captures more product detail, improving both detection and classification
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with imgsz=1280, epochs=200, adjust batch size for GPU memory (likely batch=8-16 on A800). Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over previous best

plan.title: Train YOLOv8l with nc=357 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Larger model with high resolution further improves performance
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l with imgsz=1280, epochs=300, batch=8. Monitor training and compute val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over YOLOv8m

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x provides the best single-model detection and classification performance
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with imgsz=1280, epochs=300-500, batch=4-8, close_mosaic=50. This is expected to be the strongest single YOLO model.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over YOLOv8l

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x with nc=1 (detection only) at 1280
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection recall since it doesn't need to distinguish 357 classes
plan.description: Convert annotations to single class (all category_id=0). Train YOLOv8x with nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=300. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. This will be the detection backbone for the two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 is higher than the nc=357 model's detection_mAP@0.5

plan.title: Tune NMS and confidence thresholds on val split
plan.hypothesis: Optimizing NMS IoU threshold and confidence threshold improves val_score by 1-3 points
plan.description: Using the best YOLO model so far, sweep: conf_threshold in [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3], iou_threshold in [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8]. Evaluate val_score for each combination. Dense shelves may benefit from lower NMS threshold.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal conf/iou thresholds, val_score improvement logged

plan.title: Test TTA (test-time augmentation) on val split
plan.hypothesis: TTA with multi-scale and flip improves detection mAP by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run inference with augment=True on the best YOLO model. Measure val_score and inference time. Compare to non-TTA baseline.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement quantified, inference time measured to check feasibility within 300s budget

plan.title: Explore product reference images for embedding-based classification
plan.description: Analyze data/products/ directory: count products with reference images, count images per product, check image quality/size. Cross-reference with annotation categories to see coverage. Determine how many of the 357 categories have reference images available.
plan.success_criteria: Know exactly which categories have reference images, how many images per category, and coverage gaps

plan.title: Build DINOv2-based embedding pipeline
plan.description: Implement a pipeline that: (1) loads DINOv2-base from torch hub or timm, (2) extracts embeddings from image crops, (3) builds a gallery from reference product images + training annotation crops, (4) classifies a query crop via kNN against the gallery. Test on a few val crops to verify it produces reasonable results.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline produces embeddings, gallery is built, kNN classification returns category predictions

plan.title: Two-stage baseline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2-base kNN classification
plan.hypothesis: Two-stage approach (detect then classify with embeddings) achieves higher val_score than single-stage nc=357 YOLO
plan.description: Use the nc=1 YOLO detector for boxes, then classify each crop with DINOv2-base kNN. Evaluate full val_score. Compare to best nc=357 YOLO result.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to best single-stage model, improvement quantified

plan.title: Tune kNN hyperparameters for DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Optimizing k, temperature, and distance metric improves classification mAP
plan.description: Sweep k in [1, 3, 5, 7, 11], temperature in [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5], distance metric (cosine, L2). Also test distance-weighted vs majority voting. Evaluate classification_mAP@0.5 on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN configuration found, classification mAP improvement logged

plan.title: Gallery composition experiment
plan.hypothesis: The ratio of reference images to training crops in the gallery affects classification quality
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (1) reference images only, (2) training crops only, (3) both with equal weight, (4) references weighted 3x, (5) training crops weighted 2x. Evaluate classification_mAP@0.5 for each.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified, classification mAP improvement logged

plan.title: Compare DINOv2-base vs DINOv2-small embeddings
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-base significantly outperforms DINOv2-small for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Build galleries with both DINOv2-base and DINOv2-small. Compare classification_mAP@0.5 on val split. Also measure inference time per crop for budget planning.
plan.success_criteria: Quantified accuracy difference between base and small, inference time measured

plan.title: Implement SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on high-res images improves detection of small products by 3-5 mAP points
plan.description: Implement sliced inference: split each ~2000x1500 image into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles (stride ~960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Use the best YOLO model. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 and full val_score. Measure total inference time.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 improves over non-tiled inference, total inference time within budget

plan.title: Optimize tiling parameters
plan.hypothesis: Tile size and overlap affect detection quality; optimal parameters depend on product sizes
plan.description: Sweep tile sizes [640, 960, 1280] and overlaps [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]. Also test with and without full-image inference. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 and inference time for each configuration.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal tiling parameters found, best detection_mAP@0.5 logged

plan.title: Train RT-DETR-l for ensemble diversity
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l has different error patterns than YOLO, making it a good ensemble partner
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l (available in ultralytics 8.1.0) with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=300. Evaluate standalone val_score and compare to best YOLO.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l trained, standalone val_score logged, error pattern differences noted

plan.title: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=1 for detection ensemble
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l nc=1 provides complementary detections to YOLO nc=1
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=300. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 standalone.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l nc=1 detection_mAP@0.5 logged

plan.title: WBF ensemble of YOLO + RT-DETR detections
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO and RT-DETR with WBF improves detection mAP by 2-4 points over best single model
plan.description: Combine predictions from best YOLO and RT-DETR models using Weighted Boxes Fusion (ensemble-boxes package). Sweep WBF IoU threshold [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7] and weights. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO classes vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification mAP
plan.description: For each detection, compare YOLO nc=357 class confidence vs DINOv2 embedding similarity. Implement a gating mechanism: use YOLO class if confidence > threshold, else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep the confidence threshold on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Gated approach achieves higher classification_mAP@0.5 than either method alone

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference for robust embeddings
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations reduces sensitivity to exact box boundaries
plan.description: For each detection, extract 3-4 crop variations: (1) original box, (2) center 80% crop, (3) 10% padded crop, (4) slight brightness adjustment. Average embeddings before kNN lookup. Evaluate classification_mAP@0.5 improvement.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves over single-crop approach

plan.title: Train fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 features
plan.hypothesis: A learned projection head on frozen DINOv2 features improves product discrimination
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, train a 2-layer MLP projection head using ArcFace or contrastive loss on training crops + reference images. The head maps 768-dim to 256-dim embedding space optimized for product similarity. Evaluate classification_mAP@0.5.
plan.success_criteria: Projection head improves classification_mAP@0.5 over raw DINOv2 features

plan.title: Extract crops from full-resolution images for DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Cropping from original ~2000x1500 images preserves more detail than from YOLO's resized input
plan.description: Ensure DINOv2 crops are extracted from original resolution images, not from YOLO's 1280px input. Compare embedding quality (classification_mAP@0.5) between full-res crops and resized-image crops.
plan.success_criteria: Full-res crops produce better classification_mAP@0.5

plan.title: YOLOv8x training with longer epochs and close_mosaic tuning
plan.hypothesis: Longer training (500+ epochs) with extended close_mosaic period improves final accuracy
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with epochs=500, close_mosaic=100 (last 100 epochs without mosaic). Compare to the 300-epoch model. Also try epochs=800 with close_mosaic=150 if time permits.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over shorter training

plan.title: Progressive resolution training
plan.hypothesis: Training at 640 first then fine-tuning at 1280 is faster and may generalize better
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at imgsz=640 for 100 epochs, then resume at imgsz=1280 for 200 more epochs. Compare val_score and total training time to direct 1280 training.
plan.success_criteria: Comparable or better val_score with reduced training time

plan.title: Label smoothing for nc=357 training
plan.hypothesis: Label smoothing helps with noisy labels and visually similar categories
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with label_smoothing=0.1 and compare to no label smoothing. Keep all other hyperparameters the same.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference product images
plan.hypothesis: Pasting reference product images onto shelf backgrounds increases training data for rare categories
plan.description: Implement copy-paste augmentation: for rare categories (appearing <5 times), paste reference product images onto random shelf backgrounds with perspective warps and lighting adjustments. Retrain YOLOv8x with augmented data.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves, especially classification_mAP for rare categories

plan.title: Class-balanced sampling / focal loss for rare categories
plan.hypothesis: Oversampling rare categories or using focal loss prevents the model from ignoring them
plan.description: Implement image-level oversampling where images containing rare categories are repeated. Alternatively, adjust focal loss gamma. Retrain and evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP for rare categories improves without hurting overall val_score

plan.title: Rectangular inference mode
plan.hypothesis: rect=True preserves aspect ratio better and may improve detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run inference with rect=True on the best YOLO model. Compare val_score to square inference.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: DINOv2-large embedding quality test
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces significantly better embeddings for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large (ViT-L/14), build gallery, evaluate classification_mAP@0.5 on val split. Compare to DINOv2-base. Measure model size and inference time to assess feasibility within 420MB budget.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement quantified, size/time feasibility assessed

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO model
plan.hypothesis: INT8 quantization reduces model size by ~50% with minimal accuracy loss
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX with INT8 quantization. Evaluate val_score and compare to FP16. Measure size savings.
plan.success_criteria: Size reduction quantified, val_score drop < 1 point

plan.title: Budget-optimized model combination: YOLOv8l + DINOv2-large
plan.hypothesis: Trading YOLO size (x→l) for better embeddings (base→large) improves overall val_score
plan.description: If DINOv2-large shows significant classification improvement, test YOLOv8l FP16 (~85MB) + DINOv2-large FP16 (~300MB) combination. Compare total val_score to YOLOv8x + DINOv2-base.
plan.success_criteria: Total val_score comparison, fits within 420MB budget

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Products on the same shelf section are correlated; using co-occurrence improves classification
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data (which categories appear in the same image). At inference, use detected high-confidence products to bias classification of uncertain detections. Implement as Bayesian prior on kNN probabilities.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves with co-occurrence priors

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling at test time
plan.hypothesis: Adding high-confidence test-time detections to the gallery improves classification of repeated products
plan.description: Two-pass inference: (1) run full pipeline on all test images, (2) add crops with score > 0.85 to DINOv2 gallery, (3) re-classify all detections with augmented gallery. Products appearing multiple times across test images get better coverage.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves on second pass

plan.title: Per-category adaptive confidence thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Different categories have different optimal confidence thresholds for classification
plan.description: For each category, find the optimal confidence threshold on val split that maximizes its contribution to classification_mAP. Categories with unique packaging can use lower thresholds; visually similar ones need higher thresholds or fallback to category_id=0.
plan.success_criteria: Per-category thresholds improve overall classification_mAP

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching individual patch tokens instead of global embeddings is more robust to occlusion
plan.description: Instead of using CLS token or mean-pooled embedding, use patch-level tokens from DINOv2. Implement patch-level matching (e.g., max-similarity across patches) between query crop and gallery entries. Evaluate classification_mAP@0.5.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP comparison with global embedding approach

plan.title: CLAHE preprocessing for shelf images
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detect products in poorly lit shelf areas
plan.description: Apply CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) to images before detection. Compare val_score with and without preprocessing.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: Smaller YOLO + more tiles tradeoff
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with more tiles beats YOLOv8x with fewer tiles due to higher effective resolution
plan.description: Compare: (1) YOLOv8x on full image + 4 tiles, (2) YOLOv8m on full image + 9 tiles. Both should fit within 300s inference budget. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5.
plan.success_criteria: Determine which configuration achieves higher detection mAP within time budget

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs standard NMS for dense shelves
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS preserves more overlapping product detections than hard NMS
plan.description: Implement Soft-NMS (Gaussian or linear decay) as post-processing. Compare to standard NMS on val split. Dense shelves with touching products may benefit.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 comparison logged

plan.title: Ensemble: nc=357 YOLO boxes + nc=1 YOLO boxes with WBF
plan.hypothesis: Combining nc=357 and nc=1 detections captures both classification-aware and recall-maximizing boxes
plan.description: Merge nc=357 and nc=1 YOLO predictions using WBF. For nc=1 boxes, assign class via DINOv2. For nc=357 boxes, keep YOLO class or override with DINOv2 if more confident. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds either model alone

plan.title: Build optimized inference pipeline for submission
plan.description: Create run.py that implements the best configuration found so far. Optimize for: (1) batch processing of crops for DINOv2, (2) efficient tiling if used, (3) GPU memory management, (4) total inference time < 300s on L4. Export models to ONNX FP16 if needed.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct predictions.json, total inference time < 300s estimated

plan.title: ONNX export and inference speed benchmark
plan.hypothesis: ONNX inference is faster than PyTorch for the submission environment
plan.description: Export best YOLO and DINOv2 models to ONNX FP16. Benchmark inference speed on val split. Compare to PyTorch inference. Verify predictions match.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX inference produces same val_score, speed improvement quantified

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x at 1920 resolution
plan.hypothesis: Even higher resolution training captures more product detail for dense shelves
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at imgsz=1920 with reduced batch size (batch=2-4, gradient accumulation). May need to use YOLOv8l or m if memory is insufficient. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison with 1280 training logged

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting manually verified annotations improves model quality
plan.description: Check if annotations have a 'corrected' field. If so, duplicate corrected annotations in training data (effectively 2x weight). Retrain and evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: Embedding ensemble: DINOv2 + CLIP for classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining DINOv2 visual embeddings with CLIP text-image embeddings improves classification
plan.description: Use CLIP to encode product names from metadata.json as text embeddings. For each detection crop, compute both DINOv2 and CLIP image embeddings. Combine similarity scores for classification. CLIP may help distinguish products with different names but similar appearance.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP comparison with DINOv2-only approach

plan.title: Spatial consistency post-processing
plan.hypothesis: Products on the same shelf row are likely the same category; spatial consistency improves classification
plan.description: After initial classification, group detections by approximate shelf row (similar y-coordinates). Within each row, if multiple adjacent detections have similar embeddings, assign them the same category (majority vote). This exploits the fact that stores stock identical products side-by-side.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves with spatial consistency

plan.title: Score calibration for ensemble models
plan.hypothesis: Calibrating confidence scores before WBF fusion improves ensemble quality
plan.description: Different models produce differently scaled confidence scores. Apply temperature scaling or Platt scaling to each model's scores using val split. Then re-run WBF ensemble.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score improves with calibrated scores

plan.title: Train with mixup and cutmix augmentation
plan.hypothesis: Mixup/cutmix regularization helps with the large number of categories and limited data
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with mixup=0.1 and/or copy_paste=0.1 augmentation. Compare val_score to baseline augmentation settings.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: Multi-scale inference without tiling
plan.hypothesis: Running inference at multiple scales and merging catches products at different sizes
plan.description: Run YOLO inference at imgsz=[640, 1280, 1920], merge all predictions with WBF. Compare to single-scale and tiled approaches.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison with single-scale and tiled approaches

plan.title: Optimize WBF parameters for final ensemble
plan.hypothesis: Fine-tuning WBF iou_threshold, skip_box_thr, and model weights maximizes ensemble performance
plan.description: Grid search over WBF parameters: iou_threshold [0.3-0.7], skip_box_thr [0.001-0.1], model weights. Use the best combination of models identified so far.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal WBF parameters found, best ensemble val_score logged

plan.title: Final pipeline assembly and optimization
plan.description: Assemble the complete best pipeline: detection (single model or ensemble) + classification (DINOv2 with best config) + post-processing (NMS/WBF, spatial consistency, co-occurrence). Optimize for inference speed. Profile each component's time contribution.
plan.success_criteria: Complete pipeline runs on val split, val_score matches expectations, inference time profiled

plan.title: End-to-end val_score verification of final pipeline
plan.hypothesis: The assembled pipeline achieves the best val_score seen across all experiments
plan.description: Run the complete final pipeline on val split. Verify val_score matches or exceeds the best individual experiment results. Check for any integration bugs.
plan.success_criteria: Final val_score is the highest achieved, no integration issues

plan.title: Package submission: export models, create run.py, verify constraints
plan.description: Export all models to submission format (ONNX FP16 or .pt). Create final run.py with correct argument parsing. Verify: total weight files ≤ 3, total size ≤ 420MB, no blocked imports, correct output format. Test run.py end-to-end on val images.
plan.success_criteria: Submission package meets all constraints, run.py produces correct predictions.json

plan.title: Inference time stress test
plan.hypothesis: The final pipeline completes inference on ~248 images within 300 seconds on a single GPU
plan.description: Simulate submission conditions: run the pipeline on all available images, measure total time. Extrapolate to test set size. If over budget, identify bottlenecks and optimize (reduce tiles, use smaller model, batch more aggressively).
plan.success_criteria: Estimated inference time < 300s for expected test set size

plan.title: Document best configuration and final val_score
plan.description: Write a summary of the best configuration found: model architecture, training hyperparameters, inference settings, classification approach, ensemble details. Report final val_score breakdown (detection_mAP, classification_mAP, combined). This is what the human operator will use to retrain on full data.
plan.success_criteria: Clear documentation of best config with reproducible settings and final val_score
